script:
Wang Writer
Wang Writer is a mystery novelist and longtime friend of Zhen Youcai. Zhen Youcai is also a fan of Wang Writer's books, always strongly supporting Wang Writer's creative endeavors. The two often exchange reasoning experiences together. After Wang Writer's wife was murdered, Wang Writer and his son have been living in Zhen Youcai's home.
The person who killed Wang Writer's wife was none other than Wang Writer himself. Two years ago, when describing perfect crime methods without being able to prove them, he set up a killing scheme himself, using his own wife as a guinea pig to test murder methods. Of course, this was helped by Zhen Youcai, because Zhen Youcai was well-informed and gave Wang Writer many fresh ideas, and also helped Wang Writer obtain many hard-to-get items. After completing the killing scheme, Wang Writer even brought his son Wang Guoqing to reason from various angles, but they couldn't deduce the real murderer - himself. Only then did he confirm the establishment of this perfect crime. Afterward, Wang Writer used this as a blueprint to create the novel "Dark and Windy Night."
He knew his son worshipped him, so he told his son that if even he couldn't solve a mystery, no police could crack it. But after publishing the novel, Wang Guoqing kept wanting to ask Wang Writer about the novel, but Wang Writer maintained his usual style, only saying he was busy with work and would discuss it later.
After a year, Wang Writer began conceiving a new novel "Castle Murder Case." To find inspiration, he brought his son to live in the castle long-term. Of course, he didn't let Zhen Youcai know about this.
Besides Zhen Youcai, the castle housed Zhen Youcai's son Zhen Gongzi, castle butler Li Butler and his daughter Zhang Xiaomei. For convenience in writing, Wang Writer also had his assistant Ding Assistant come to live in the castle.
The crime method for this castle murder case was a story of creating long-term psychological pressure on the victim, forcing them to commit suicide. For this, Wang Writer searched for extensive materials, investigating various methods that could cause mental breakdown. But because these were only materials from books, to prove the authenticity and feasibility of the case, Wang Writer set his sights on the castle lord Zhen Youcai.
Zhen Youcai had a habit of listening to vinyl CDs every night. Wang Writer secretly replaced Zhen Youcai's records with CDs mixed with short segments of terrifying sounds. Then every night after Zhen Youcai turned off the lights, he would create dim shadows around the room accompanied by unclear whispers. Sure enough, within a few days, Zhen Youcai felt something was wrong and began visiting doctors. Zhen Youcai came to Wang Writer to complain, and Wang Writer took the opportunity to give Zhen Youcai some medicine. These medicines were normal psychiatric treatment drugs, but when taken in excess, they had side effects like mania, and long-term large doses could even cause serious mental illness.
After Zhen Youcai took the medicine, Wang Writer stopped operating these strange phenomena, but he would often check Zhen Youcai's medication dosage. Whenever it didn't meet his requirements, he would make Zhen Youcai experience "ghostly sounds and shadows" again. Over time, Zhen Youcai could no longer withstand it. His spirit became increasingly dispirited, and he even contracted a serious illness - it seemed he was near death.
On December 1st, Wang Writer and Ding Assistant were organizing materials in their room when Zhen Youcai suddenly found Wang Writer and told him a secret. Actually, Li Butler's daughter Zhang Xiaomei was Zhen Youcai's illegitimate daughter, not Li Butler's daughter - he had Li Butler adopt her. He hadn't been able to take responsibility for Zhang Xiaomei's biological mother back then, and he felt very guilty. Now that he was dying, he hoped to divide his property equally between Zhang Xiaomei and Zhen Gongzi, rather than leaving everything to Zhen Gongzi as originally planned. He would announce this news on December 10th and wanted Wang Writer to help him as a witness, to prevent Zhang Xiaomei and Zhen Gongzi from fighting over money. Additionally, Zhen Youcai told Wang Writer there was another matter he couldn't discuss now, asking Wang Writer to come to his room alone in a couple days to discuss it, and handed him a note that read "Beware of your assistant."
But Wang Writer paid no attention to these things. Having invested so much effort and constantly recording Zhen Youcai's behavior, to give this real-life novel a perfect ending, Wang Writer needed to see a Zhen Youcai who "died by suicide."
[December 5th Evening]
Around 10 PM, having finished his work, Wang Writer prepared to go to Zhen Youcai's room, carrying rope and planning to stage a hanging suicide scene. Zhen Youcai was truly wealthy - the castle had over a hundred rooms, and it took more than ten minutes to walk from Wang Writer's room to Zhen Youcai's. Walking along the way, Wang Writer suddenly heard sounds behind him. Looking back, he only saw a hand rapidly enlarging before his eyes. With a bang, Wang Writer lost consciousness. Late at night, Wang Writer woke up and rushed to Zhen Youcai's room, finding the door slightly open. Through the crack and moonlight, he saw that Zhen Youcai was already hanging dead from the beam. Since that was the case, Wang Writer's purpose had been achieved. He returned to his room, put away the rope, and it was already 12:30 AM.
